sentences.text:
, THIS DAY,
ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SACHIN SHANKAR MAGADUM
ORAL ORDER

This petition is filed by the husband and his family members seeking quashing of the proceedings in C.C.No.9228/2025 for the offence punishable under Section 498(A), 323, 504, 506, 34 of IPC read with Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
2. Today, a joint application for compounding has been filed under Section 320 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, read with Section 359 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
The said application is supported by the parties and is placed on record.
3. Respondent No.2/wife is present before this Court and has been duly identified by her learned counsel.

Upon a specific query from the Court, she has categorically acknowledged that the matrimonial dispute between her NC: 2025:KHC:30656 HC-KAR and petitioner No.1, as well as the issues involving petitioner Nos.2 and 3 (her in-laws), has been amicably resolved in terms of a settlement recorded in M.C.No.4398/2025 before the competent Family Court.

4. Respondent No.2 further states that, in view of the settlement, she does not wish to prosecute the criminal proceedings any further and has voluntarily tendered her no objection for quashing the case.
The statement made by respondent No.2 is found to be voluntary, bona fide, and free from coercion or undue influence.

5. Considering that the dispute emanates from a matrimonial relationship and has been resolved amicably, and keeping in mind that the complainant herself does not wish to pursue the matter, this Court finds it appropriate to permit the parties to compound the offences.

Continuation of the criminal proceedings, in such circumstances, would only result in unnecessary hardship NC:
2025:KHC:30656 HC-KAR to the parties and would not serve the ends of justice.
Accordingly, the application filed in I.A.No.1/2025 under Section 320 Cr.P.C. read with Section 359 BNSS, 2023, is allowed.

6. Consequently, the petition is allowed and the proceedings in Crime No.0092/2024 registered by the North Women Police Station, Bengaluru, now pending as C.C.No.9228/2025 before the learned 32nd Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru, for the offences punishable under Sections 498-A, 323, 504, 506, 34 of IPC read with Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act,
1961, insofar as they relate to the petitioners, are hereby quashed.
